title: 大型 MPI 平行模擬
subcategoryTitle: 高效能運算與世界級超算
summary: 以域分解、訊息語意與數值平行驗證串連 16 個原創技術單元、32 步；涵蓋原理解析、架構圖、假想量化、合成資料實驗、競爭失效原因及可重算驗收。
summaryEn: Sixteen original technical units and 32 tasks connect domain decomposition, message semantics and numerical parallel validation with principles, architectures, assumed calculations, synthetic experiments, competing failure causes and reproducible acceptance.
scope: 公開原理的本地科教模擬與工程判讀。只使用自製、合成或明確授權的資料；不操作真實受害主機、他人帳號、工業控制或超算設施。數值不代表廠商規格或實測效能，完成課程不是專業資格、真實裝置操作經歷或生產部署認證。
scopeEn: Local educational simulation and engineering interpretation of public principles. Use self-made, synthetic or explicitly licensed data only; do not operate real victim hosts, other accounts, industrial control or supercomputing facilities. Values are not product specifications or measured performance. Completion is not a qualification, real-equipment experience or production-deployment certification.

stages.title: 問題與分解
stages.description: 四個技術單元依序完成「問題與分解」的架構與證據，共八步可分別儲存的本地科教實作。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop problems and decomposition through eight separately saved local educational tasks.

steps.title: 域分解：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「域分解」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for domain decomposition.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「域分解」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：空間分塊決定計算與跨塊依賴。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「把自製二維格網分為四塊。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for domain decomposition. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Spatial partitioning defines compute and interblock dependencies. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Partition a self-made 2D grid into four blocks. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 把自製二維格網分為四塊。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Partition a self-made 2D grid into four blocks. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：分塊越細就無條件降低總耗時。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Finer blocks always reduce total runtime. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「域分解」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「把自製二維格網分為四塊。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for domain decomposition; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

knowledge.title: 原理與架構依據
knowledge.text: 空間分塊決定計算與跨塊依賴。
knowledge.textEn: Spatial partitioning defines compute and interblock dependencies.

knowledge.title: 辨別模型的證據
knowledge.text: 把自製二維格網分為四塊。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: Partition a self-made 2D grid into four blocks. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

knowledge.title: 本課量化算例
knowledge.text: 玩具 3D 網格每子域邊長 L，體點 L³、單層六面 halo≈6L²，通訊體積比≈6/L。L=32 得 0.1875，L=64 得 0.09375；未含邊角、重疊與協議頭，不等於通訊時間比例。
knowledge.textEn: For a toy cubic subdomain, L3 interior cells and roughly 6L2 one-layer halo cells give volume ratio 6/L: 0.1875 at L32 and 0.09375 at L64, excluding edges, overlap and framing; not a time fraction.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「大型 MPI 平行模擬」的「域分解：原理與架構」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出輸入資料、處理狀態、傳輸與輸出的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「算力中心：核心不是答案」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與輸入版本、時間追蹤、資源計數與可重播的小型測試的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Domain decomposition: principles and architecture” in “Large-scale MPI parallel simulation”. Draw the input, processing state, transport and output boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Compute Center: Cores Are Not the Answer” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for input version, time traces, resource counters and a replayable small test, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 審查「域分解」的原理與架構時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which principle/architecture claim is justified for domain decomposition?
options: 分塊越細就無條件降低總耗時。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「域分解」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
空間分塊決定計算與跨塊依賴。
optionsEn: Finer blocks always reduce total runtime.
One matching output proves domain decomposition for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
Spatial partitioning defines compute and interblock dependencies.
quiz.explanation: 空間分塊決定計算與跨塊依賴。 把自製二維格網分為四塊。 因此「分塊越細就無條件降低總耗時。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Spatial partitioning defines compute and interblock dependencies. Partition a self-made 2D grid into four blocks. The alternative "Finer blocks always reduce total runtime." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 域分解：實驗與證據
steps.objective: 以「域分解」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for domain decomposition.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「把自製二維格網分為四塊。」；將結果與「空間分塊決定計算與跨塊依賴。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Partition a self-made 2D grid into four blocks. Compare results against: Spatial partitioning defines compute and interblock dependencies. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 把自製二維格網分為四塊。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Partition a self-made 2D grid into four blocks. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：分塊越細就無條件降低總耗時。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Finer blocks always reduce total runtime. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「域分解」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「分塊越細就無條件降低總耗時。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for domain decomposition; explain why this claim fails: Finer blocks always reduce total runtime.

quiz.question: 審查「域分解」的驗證方法時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which validation approach is justified for domain decomposition?
options: 把自製二維格網分為四塊。
分塊越細就無條件降低總耗時。
先把「域分解」的顯示結果調到符合預期，再把這次吻合當作獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Partition a self-made 2D grid into four blocks.

Tune the displayed domain decomposition result to the expected value and count that agreement as independent validation.

steps.title: 程序與執行緒：原理與架構
steps.titleEn: Processes and threads: principles and architecture
steps.objective: 以「程序與執行緒」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for processes and threads.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「程序與執行緒」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：MPI rank 與執行緒在地址空間與通訊上不同。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「畫兩 rank 各兩執行緒的資料所有權。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for processes and threads. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: MPI ranks and threads differ in address spaces and communication. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Draw data ownership for two ranks with two threads each. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 畫兩 rank 各兩執行緒的資料所有權。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Draw data ownership for two ranks with two threads each. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：不同 rank 自動共享同一普通陣列。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Different ranks automatically share ordinary arrays. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「程序與執行緒」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「畫兩 rank 各兩執行緒的資料所有權。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for processes and threads; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

steps.objective: 以「Communicator」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for communicators.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「Communicator」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：通訊域隔離訊息集合並定義 rank 身份。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「比較同程序在兩個玩具群組的 rank。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。

Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Communicators isolate message groups and rank identities. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare one process’s ranks in two toy groups. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

options: 通訊域隔離訊息集合並定義 rank 身份。
rank 編號在任何通訊域中都不變。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「Communicator」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
optionsEn: Communicators isolate message groups and rank identities.
Ranks never change across communicators.
One matching output proves communicators for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
quiz.explanation: 通訊域隔離訊息集合並定義 rank 身份。 比較同程序在兩個玩具群組的 rank。 因此「rank 編號在任何通訊域中都不變。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Communicators isolate message groups and rank identities. Compare one process’s ranks in two toy groups. The alternative "Ranks never change across communicators." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: Communicator：實驗與證據
steps.objective: 以「Communicator」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for communicators.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「比較同程序在兩個玩具群組的 rank。」；將結果與「通訊域隔離訊息集合並定義 rank 身份。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Compare one process’s ranks in two toy groups. Compare results against: Communicators isolate message groups and rank identities. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 比較同程序在兩個玩具群組的 rank。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Compare one process’s ranks in two toy groups. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：rank 編號在任何通訊域中都不變。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Ranks never change across communicators. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「Communicator」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「rank 編號在任何通訊域中都不變。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for communicators; explain why this claim fails: Ranks never change across communicators.

knowledge.text: 通訊域隔離訊息集合並定義 rank 身份。

knowledge.title: 辨別模型的證據
knowledge.text: 比較同程序在兩個玩具群組的 rank。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: Compare one process’s ranks in two toy groups. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

quiz.question: 審查「Communicator」的驗證方法時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which validation approach is justified for communicators?
options: rank 編號在任何通訊域中都不變。
比較同程序在兩個玩具群組的 rank。
先把「Communicator」的顯示結果調到符合預期，再把這次吻合當作獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Ranks never change across communicators.
Compare one process’s ranks in two toy groups.
Tune the displayed communicators result to the expected value and count that agreement as independent validation.
quiz.explanation: 通訊域隔離訊息集合並定義 rank 身份。 比較同程序在兩個玩具群組的 rank。 因此「rank 編號在任何通訊域中都不變。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Communicators isolate message groups and rank identities. Compare one process’s ranks in two toy groups. The alternative "Ranks never change across communicators." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 邊界條件：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「邊界條件」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for boundary conditions.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「邊界條件」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：物理邊界與子域內部邊界處理不同。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「標示玩具擴散格網的兩種邊界。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for boundary conditions. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Physical and interdomain boundaries are handled differently. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Mark both boundary types on a toy diffusion grid. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 標示玩具擴散格網的兩種邊界。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Mark both boundary types on a toy diffusion grid. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：所有子域邊界都應設零值。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Every subdomain boundary should be zero. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「邊界條件」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「標示玩具擴散格網的兩種邊界。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for boundary conditions; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.
